data.group: Death Company Marines with Boltguns and Jump Packs
data.summary:
Each of these can attach to this unit instead:

- a **CHAPLAIN** model of yours with the **[Leader](vsdata:core-ability/leader)** ability that could lead **ASSAULT INTERCESSORS WITH JUMP PACKS** or **ASSAULT SQUAD WITH JUMP PACKS** units
- a **CHARACTER** unit of yours with the **[Leader](vsdata:core-ability/leader)** ability that could attach to **DEATH COMPANY MARINES WITH JUMP PACKS**
